name: Shades of the Night
source:
A harmless Halloween ritual, a silly dare… but when Alissa follows the instructions, reality starts to twist. Shadows whisper, lights flicker, and the lines between friend and foe blur. 

Can she survive the night – or will curiosity trap her forever?

[From [url=https://mhalia-loopy.itch.io/shades-of-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
